message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**Apple FY2024 (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024) key figures from the 10-K:**
- **Total net sales: $391,035 million** (up 2% from $383,285M in FY2023)
- Products $294,866M; Services $96,169M (+13% YoY, the main growth driver)
- Gross margin $180,683M (46.2% of net sales, up from 44.1%)
- Operating income $123,216M; net income $93,736M; diluted EPS $6.08
- Cash generated by operating activities $118,254M
- Net income was depressed by a one-time $10.2B net tax charge related to the EU State Aid Decision (effective tax rate 24.1% vs. 14.7% prior year) — an item that doesn't reflect operating deterioration
- Liquidity: $140.8B in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities; $95.0B of stock repurchased in FY2024

**Order placed:** Buy 40 shares of AAPL, limit $222.90 (quote at time of decision: last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72 — limit set just above the ask to ensure execution while staying within a few basis points of market). Filled at $222.90 for a total of **$8,916**, which is under the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily cap; this is the only order placed today, so total notional today is $8,916. No funds were transferred out of the account, and the trade is a buy of a permitted name (AAPL).

**Why:** Apple's FY2024 report shows a business that returned to modest top-line growth (+2% to $391.0B) with a mix shift toward high-margin Services (+13%, 73.9% services gross margin) lifting total gross margin to 46.2% and operating income to $123.2B. Headline net income ($93.7B) and EPS ($6.08) look slightly down year over year, but that is almost entirely explained by the non-recurring $10.2B State Aid tax charge — pre-tax income actually rose to $123.5B from $113.7B. Cash generation remains exceptional ($118.3B operating cash flow) and the balance sheet carries $140.8B of liquid investments, supporting continued buybacks ($95B in FY2024) and the dividend. Against a market price of ~$222.70, that's roughly 36.6x trailing diluted EPS — a full valuation, which is why I sized the position modestly (40 shares, ~$8.9K) rather than at the maximum permitted amount, and used a limit order at the market rather than chasing price.
message.reasoning:
Order filled at 222.90, 40 shares = $8,916. Within $10k per order and $20k total. No money moved out.

Summary paragraph.
